description: This module can manage a pacemaker cluster and nodes from Ansible using the pacemaker CLI.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force the change of the cluster state. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Specify which node of the cluster you want to manage. null == the cluster status itself, all == check the status of all nodes.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicate desired state of the cluster. The value maintenance has been added in community.general 11.1.0. Choices: "cleanup" "offline" "online" "restart" "maintenance"

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout period (in seconds) for polling the cluster operation. Default: 300

examples:
- name: Set cluster Online
  hosts: localhost
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Get cluster state
      community.general.pacemaker_cluster:
        state: online

return_values.name: out
return_values.description: The output of the current state of the cluster. It returns a list of the nodes state. Returned: always Sample: "out: [[\" overcloud-controller-0\", \" Online\"]]}"
